# E04 正态分布

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E04Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("正态分布", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E04_1_1", "正态分布的密度曲线关于均值对称。均值决定中心，标准差决定分散程度。", "", tts_text="正态分布的密度曲线关于均值对称。均值决定中心，标准差决定分散程度。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2),\quad \sigma>0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E04_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E04_1_2", "它的概率密度由均值和标准差这两个参数确定。", "", tts_text="它的概率密度由均值和标准差这两个参数确定。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"f(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma}e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E04_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E04Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("正态分布", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E04_2_1", "均值改变时，分布中心平移；标准差增大时，曲线变宽、峰值降低。", "", tts_text="均值改变时，分布中心平移；标准差增大时，曲线变宽、峰值降低。")
        line_1 = Text("均值：中心；标准差：离散程度", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E04_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E04_2_2", "概率是密度曲线下的面积，而不是某一点处的密度值。", "", tts_text="概率是密度曲线下的面积，而不是某一点处的密度值。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"P(a<X<b)=\int_a^b f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E04_2_2")
        self.start_cue("E04_2_3", "标准化时减去均值再除以标准差，不是除以方差。", "", tts_text="标准化时减去均值再除以标准差，不是除以方差。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"Z=\frac{X-\mu}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E04_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E04Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("正态分布", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E04_3_1", "例题：X 服从均值十、方差四的正态分布，求 X 等于十二对应的标准化数值。", "", tts_text="例题：X 服从均值十、方差四的正态分布，求 X 等于十二对应的标准化数值。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"X\sim N(10,4)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E04_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E04_3_2", "标准差为二，所以十二减十再除以二，等于一。", "", tts_text="标准差为二，所以十二减十再除以二，等于一。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"z=\frac{12-10}{2}=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E04_3_2")
        self.start_cue("E04_3_3", "若求 X 不超过十二的概率，即标准正态分布在一点的分布函数值。", "", tts_text="若求 X 不超过十二的概率，即标准正态分布在一点的分布函数值。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"P(X\le12)=\Phi(1)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E04_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E04_3_3")
```
